sentences.text: Ofcom has launched an investigation into Pornhub owner, Aylo, over whether the site's new age checks are effectively stopping children from accessing adult content.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: The regulator said in May that Pornhub started using a new age verification process for some users, which relied on a third party, Apple.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: It said it had concerns that Aylo "may not have conducted sufficient due diligence and testing" before implementing this new process, and so it "may not be highly effective" at preventing children from seeing pornography.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: In a lengthy statement given to the BBC, Aylo strongly defended its system for age verification while stressing it would cooperate fully with the investigation.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: Under the UK's Online Safety Act (OSA), sites that host pornographic material must use highly effective age assurance to ensure users are over 18, but it leaves it up to the service to decide the method of age-checking it will use.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: Ofcom says as part of its investigation it will consider how Aylo implements its age verification processes and whether it conducted the "necessary due diligence" before it was implemented.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: It will not investigate how Apple operates its age checks.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: George Lusty, Ofcom's Director of Enforcement, said: "Online age checks are a vital protection to prevent children from encountering inappropriate or harmful material, including pornography.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: "We expect tech firms to ensure age checks are highly effective before introducing them.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: Anything less could leave children at risk." But Aylo argues that, having experimented in multiple markets with multiple age-check methods, Apple's system "provides significantly stronger protection than any other age assurance method currently available in the UK market".
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: It also notes that Ofcom had previously praised Apple's technology as "a real win for children and families".
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: Aylo argues a system based on asking individual pornographic sites to check users ages, simply drives users to riskier sites that aren't following Ofcom's rules.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: Research by the Lucy Faithfull Foundation , external has previously suggested that non-compliant sites "may also be more likely to host harmful or illegal content, and in some cases, sexual images of children".
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: This probe is just the latest clash between the regulator and what is one of the world's most viewed porn sites.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: In October 2025 Pornhub said traffic from UK users had plunged by more than 75% following the introduction of more robust age checks by the OSA.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: Some have questioned whether people were simply using Virtual Private Networks (VPN) to get around the checks instead.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: In January, Pornhub announced it would restrict access to its website in the UK, blaming the tougher checks, with only people who had previously made a Pornhub account able to access its content.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: Aylo said that updates to the Act requiring age verification had "not achieved its goal of protecting minors".
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: However, in May, it said it would be making the site available again for some UK Apple users who had confirmed their age with the company's most up-to-date version of iOS, its mobile operating system.
sentences.article_title: Pornhub investigated over its age checks

sentences.text: The tech giant OpenAI will share its AI cyber defence system Daybreak for free with the Ukraine government to help it protect civilian infrastructure, like hospitals and power plants, from cyber-attacks.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: According to the Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA), the national cyber incident response team, Ukraine recorded nearly 6,000 attacks in 2025.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Daybreak is able to quickly identify weaknesses in digital systems and help develop fixes.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Under the deal, Ukraine will get access to OpenAI's advanced GPT 5.6 Sol model - a rival to Anthropic's Mythos and Fable.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: "Any initiative that strengthens Ukraine's already highly capable, but heavily burdened, cyber defence efforts is a welcome development and could provide a valuable force multiplier," he said.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Jamie MacColl, a senior research fellow specialising in cyber at the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI), told the BBC western tech firms had been supporting Ukraine for some time - partly for altruistic reasons but also because they gain very valuable data and intelligence from an active conflict.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: "Given this, it's no surprise that OpenAI is now also providing defensive cyber security services" he said.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: He thought access to Daybreak would be useful, particularly given the volume of Russian cyber-attacks targeting the country.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: But he noted Ukraine already had access to AI tools provided by OpenAI's competitors, like Google.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: The cyber-abilities of the latest, most powerful AI models, called "frontier" models in AI jargon, can be a boon for cyber-defenders, but the same abilities can also be used for attack.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Spotting weaknesses in systems, for example, is useful for defenders looking to block hackers, but also for attackers hunting for ways to infiltrate an organisation.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Anthropic has tightly restricted access to its systems on the grounds that they are too powerful to fall into the wrong hands, but OpenAI has allowed some firms in Europe, as well as UK banks, to use its most advanced cyber models.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: The firm made the announcement alongside the UN General Assembly which is currently underway in New York.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: AI is firmly on the agenda there, and US tech bosses including OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei are due to speak at the high-level gathering.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: United Nations Secretary General António Guterres called for the tech to be regulated in his final address, while US President Donald Trump says it should be renamed "super intelligence".
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Evidence suggests the technology is increasingly being used in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: In a report published earlier this month, Anthropic claimed that its Claude platform appeared to have been used by a group of Russian developers to build software for a swarm of so-called "kamikaze" drones designed for attacks in Ukraine.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: It said the group had activated virtual private networks - VPNs - in order to get around a geographical block put in place by the tech firm.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Anthropic also claimed AI had been used in attempts to infiltrate the Ukrainian government, military and diplomatic services.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Recently, around 100 US companies signed an open letter warning governments and institutions around the world that "the window is closing" to ensure cyber defences are robust enough to withstand AI-enabled cyber attacks.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: But it's not just bad actors deploying the tech that are of growing concern: in the summer, OpenAI revealed that a group of AI agents it had been testing had escaped from their controls, and secretly worked together to hack to another tech firm, Hugging Face.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Anthropic , and Google subsequently revealed similar incidents.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI gives cyber defence tools to Ukraine

sentences.text: Johnny Fisher has won 14 pro fights, with 12 knockouts, and lost one When Johnny Fisher steps back inside the Copper Box Arena on Saturday night, the surroundings will feel familiar, even if much around his career has changed.

sentences.text: The east London venue was once something of a fortress for Fisher, where John Denver's 'Take Me Home, Country Roads' accompanied his ring walk and thousands of supporters reacted to every punch as his unbeaten record grew.
sentences.article_title: 'Bosh', backlash and rebuild - how far can Fisher go?

sentences.article_title: 'Bosh', backlash and rebuild - how far can Fisher go?

sentences.text: Now the 27-year-old returns to headline against Belgium's Michael Pirotton in a 10-round contest which also marks his promotional debut for Dana White's Zuffa Boxing.
sentences.article_title: 'Bosh', backlash and rebuild - how far can Fisher go?

sentences.article_title: 'Bosh', backlash and rebuild - how far can Fisher go?

sentences.text: "There are many, many people before me who are much better than me who have lost and come back." 'Big John' Fisher's viral takeaway reviews and "Bosh!" catchphrase have earned him a huge social media following Fisher's rise has been far from conventional.

sentences.text: JJ Gabriel is one of the most highly-rated prospects in English football A 15-year-old growing up in the UK faces many tough personal decisions about their future - which school subjects to study, which social circle suits them, and where their priorities lie in life.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: But in the past few weeks the choices teenage Manchester United striker JJ Gabriel has been making about his future in football have drawn huge public attention in sports media and online.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Gabriel has informed United he wants to leave the club and join another.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: BBC Sport has reported that he has stayed away from training and begun talking to other clubs because he and his representatives are unhappy with United's handling of the 15-year-old's progress.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: That a transfer saga involving a footballer so young could generate so much interest highlights a truth that to many is uncomfortable - money is changing how the football transfer market works, and children are increasingly deemed to be among its most valuable commodities.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: So what is behind the rise in transfers involving boys who in some cases are not even old enough to have taken their GCSEs, what kind of influence can the money on offer have on agents and parents, and what exactly are the country's top football clubs getting out of it?
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "It's crazy when you think about it," says Ryan Cardwell, former youth scout at Liverpool and Southampton.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "In what other kind of world would 15 and 16-year-olds be spoken about in the media like this?" This summer alone, all six of the Premier League's wealthiest clubs either signed a highly-rated academy player from another, or lost a youngster to a direct rival.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "It is such a competitive market," Cardwell explains.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "There are now tens of transfers between the elite academies every summer, when it used to be the case that if you were already at one of those, you would likely stay the course.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: One of the major factors is Brexit.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Before 2021 English clubs were allowed to sign academy players over the age of 16 who held European Union passports.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Since the UK left the EU, foreign players cannot join English clubs until they reach 18.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "Heathrow and Gatwick [airports] on a Friday night were inundated with scouts going to other countries to look for young players", says Caldwell.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "Belgium and the Netherlands were full of scouts for Premier League clubs.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Advances in video technology and data analysis mean more young players are being identified, tracked and approached by rival clubs than ever before.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Rio Ngumoha was one of the country's highest-rated young prospects at Chelsea, and has now made 22 Premier League appearances for Liverpool Players can de-register from their academy at the end of their under-12, under-14 and under-16 seasons if they wish to explore options elsewhere.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: They can be offered paid scholarship contracts from the season in which they turn 14, and can sign professional deals from the season in which they turn 16.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Some pundits and fans have criticised Gabriel's family over the controversy in recent weeks.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Gabriel can potentially join clubs in Europe because he has an Irish passport.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "It's a really tough world - players and families want the best for their kids and you can't give them stick without knowing what their motivations are," says Phil Jagielka, whose son Zac left Liverpool in 2024 and signed a scholarship deal at Hull City at 16.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "The harsh reality is that if a young player fails to progress, or gets a bad injury, teams will stop being interested in them.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: So there is an element of strike while the iron's hot." When a club signs a player from a rival academy, they pay a set compensation fee based on how long they had been trained there.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Depending on the player's age, the fee can reach millions of pounds.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: The increasing allure of signing young academy players from rivals means some parents are now compiling data packs on their sons to give to potential clubs, and more and more children are represented by football agents.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "There are good agents and bad agents," Cardwell says.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "You certainly speak to some and think 'that's completely the wrong idea', or, ' this player is going to be misguided'.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Sometimes they push for a move when a player isn't ready.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "The contracts can be enormous and [money] can be a huge motivation to move.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: It could set a young player's family up for life.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "I would quite like to see some form of financial cap.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: There are 31 Category 1 academies, including Manchester United, and the competition between them is significant In decades gone by, development of academy players would be combined with menial tasks around the training ground.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: The idea was to keep young footballers grounded and make them feel a part of the wider club.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: But the Gabriel case demonstrates the significant changes football has undergone.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "We would clean boots, sweep floors, tidy the changing rooms," says Jagielka, who came through Sheffield United's academy in the late 1990s.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "I fully back that system.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: It taught us responsibility and discipline.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: It was a way of getting to know the first-team players, and you would get a proper telling off if you didn't do your jobs properly.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "There was nowhere near as much outside influence on young players back then.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Now there is an entourage, people wanting to play the long game with, 9, 10, 11-year-olds because of the millions of pounds of commission if they turn out to be a superstar.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "There are far more people out there now who are prepared to rock the boat between the different clubs." The public scrutiny on young players has increased significantly, and the elite clubs' desire to succeed in the market means that high-profile youth transfers involving big money seem to be here to stay.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "Young players now have such a big platform on social media that intrigue is part of day-to-day life for them," says Cardwell.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: "When you're in elite sport you have to grow up really, really fast.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: Teenagers are expected to cope with the pressure and naturally some people fall into the trap of thinking 'well, he's a young man already' and forget about everything else.
sentences.article_title: Why schoolboys have become a huge part of football's transfer market

sentences.text: This video can not be played A red carpet and military flyover - How Trump welcomed Xi At least so far, Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington has been all pomp and little obvious progress on pressing issues.

sentences.text: From the ceremonial welcoming at a military air base on Wednesday to the honour-guard arrival at the White House this morning, President Donald Trump rolled out the red carpet – literally and figuratively – for his Chinese counterpart.
sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.text: "Let us keep advancing the cause of friendship between our two peoples and work together to build a better world," he said.
sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.text: Trump, for his part, outlined some of the topics the leaders planned to discuss in their meetings, including "pressing issues concerning security, technology, and superintelligence" - using his preferred term for artificial intelligence.

sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.text: "This is very much how President Trump sees the summit and the role he plays in the US-China relationship, as ballast to provide stability." Even so, there is still an edge to some of Xi's rhetoric, she notes.

sentences.text: "China and the United States are different in national conditions, but through candid, in-depth and continued dialogue, our two countries can understand each other better, seek common ground while shelving differences, and build up mutual trust," Xi said.
sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.text: The obstacles in the way of reaching any substantive agreement between the two nations are significant, however.
sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.article_title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far

sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: The restrictions include access to the entirety of the White House grounds, not just the press pool.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: And they target entire news organisations, not just a single disfavoured correspondent.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: While Trump has been clear about the motives behind his decision, he has shed little light on why he has acted now.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: He has regularly criticised his press coverage since he first entered national politics more than a decade ago, but he said on Friday there was no specific incident that prompted his announcement.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: At the moment, however, the president is embattled.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: Even beyond the week of clear setbacks, he is in the midst of an unpopular and difficult-to-resolve war of choice in Iran, which has led to a surge in energy and other consumer prices, deflating his standing with the American public.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: Polls also suggest his party faces an uphill battle to retain control of the House of Representatives and perhaps the Senate in November's crucial midterm congressional elections.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: His attempts to improve the public's mood by touting his accomplishments in campaign events and at his Republican Party's convention earlier this month in Texas have, at least so far, proven ineffective.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: There may be more behind Trump's decision to lash out at the media this weekend.
sentences.article_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

sentences.text: But it could also simply be an indication of presidential frustration in the face of events and circumstances, some of his own making, that are turning against him.
